Working experience and occupation
Dato' Sri Tan Kong Han, the President and Chief Operating Officer of the Company since 1 July 2007, was appointed as an Executive Director of the Company on 1 January 2020 and redesignated as the President and Chief Operating Officer and Executive Director of the Company on the same day. Dato’ Sri Tan was appointed as the Deputy Chief Executive of Genting Plantations Berhad on 1 December 2010 prior to his appointment as Chief Executive and Executive Director of Genting Plantations Berhad on 1 January 2019. He has more than 13 years working experience in investment banking prior to joining Tanjong Public Limited Company as the Group Chief Operating Officer in 2003. He left Tanjong Public Limited Company in 2007 to join the Company. He serves as a director of a variety of subsidiary companies within the Genting Berhad and Genting Plantations Berhad group. He is also a member of the Board of Trustees of Yayasan Genting and Yayasan Kebajikan Komuniti Malaysia, the Administrator of The Community Chest, Malaysia, a director of Asian Centre for Genomics Technology Berhad and Genting RMTN Berhad, all of which are public companies as well as the Managing Director of Pan Malaysian Pools Sdn Bhd.

Tan Sri Lim Kok Thay was appointed as a Director of the Company on 17 August 1976, was redesignated as the Chairman and Chief Executive of the Company on 1 July 2007. He was the Chairman and Chief Executive of Genting Malaysia Berhad until he was redesignated as the Deputy Chairman and Chief Executive of Genting Malaysia Berhad on 27 August 2020. He was also the Chief Executive and a Director of Genting Plantations Berhad until he relinquished his position as Chief Executive and assumed the position of Deputy Chairman and Executive Director of Genting Plantations Berhad on 1 January 2019. He is the Executive Chairman of Genting Singapore Limited and the Chairman of Genting UK Plc. He has served in various positions within the Group since 1976. He is a Founding Member and a Permanent Trustee of The Community Chest, Malaysia. In addition, he sits on the Boards of other Malaysian and foreign companies as well as the Boards of Trustees of several charitable organisations in Malaysia.

Ms Loh Wai Yee is appointed as the Chief Financial Officer of Genting Malaysia Berhad with effect from 1 April 2025. She is responsible for the Finance, Risk Management, Procurement and Regulatory Compliance functions of the Company. She joined the Company in June 2023 as the Senior Vice President - Finance and was redesignated as the Deputy Chief Financial Officer (Resorts World Genting) on 1 August 2023. She has over 30 years of work experience in finance, strategy, investments management, risk management and audit. Prior to joining the Company, she held senior leadership positions with Tenaga Nasional Berhad, Destination Resort and Hotel Sdn Bhd, and Penerbangan Malaysia Berhad. She also spent several years in the Investment Division of Khazanah Nasional Berhad, the sovereign wealth fund of Malaysia.Prior to joining the commercial sector, she trained as a chartered accountant in a public accounting firm in London before returning to PricewaterhouseCoopers, Kuala Lumpur as an audit senior and rose to rank of senior manager.

GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM" OR "COMPANY")PROPOSED ACQUISITION BY GENTING ER LIMITED, AN INDIRECT WHOLLY-OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF GENM OF REMAINING 51% MEMBERSHIP INTEREST IN GENTING EMPIRE RESORTS LLC ("GERL") FROM KIEN HUAT REALTY III LIMITED
Unless otherwise stated, the exchange rate of USD1.00: RM4.3170 being Bank Negara Malaysia’s middle rate as at 5.00 p.m. on 30 April 2025, is used throughout this announcement for purpose of translation of USD into RM.
The Board of Directors of GENM (“
Board
”) refers to GENM’s announcements dated 6 August 2019, 15 August 2019, 20 August 2019, 5 November 2019, 14 November 2019 and 18 November 2019 (collectively, “
Announcements
”) in respect of the Proposed Transactions. On 19 March 2020, GENM had announced the issuance of up to USD40 million of Series G Preferred Stock of Empire Resorts Inc. (“
Empire
”) (“
Series G
”). On 11 September 2020, 19 March 2021 and 12 October 2021, GENM had announced the issuance of up to USD150 million, USD20 million and USD150 million of Series L Preferred Stock of Empire respectively (“
Series L
”), and on 10 January 2024, GENM had announced the issuance of up to USD100 million of Series M Preferred Stock of Empire (collectively, “
Equity Injection Announcements
”). On 5 December 2022, GENM announced its acquisition of Empire’s entire 1,510 Series F Convertible Preferred Stock from Kien Huat Realty III Limited (“
KH
”) for a total consideration of USD100 million (“
Series F Acquisition Announcement
”). The definitions used throughout this announcement, unless stated otherwise, shall have the same meaning(s) as those used in the Announcements, Equity Injection Announcements and the Series F Acquisition Announcement.
The Board wishes to announce that GENM’s indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Genting ER Limited (“
Genting ER Limited
”), an Isle of Man incorporated entity, had on 1 May 2025 (United States Eastern date/time) entered into a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement with KH to acquire the remaining 51% membership interest in GERL from KH and concurrently, to accept the assignment of the intercompany loan owing by Empire to KH amounting to USD39.7 million (including accrued interest), collectively for a total cash consideration of USD41.0 million (or approximately RM177.0 million) (“
Purchase Consideration
”) (“
Proposed Acquisition
”).

body:
Type

Reply to Bursa Malaysia's Query Letter - Reference ID
IQL-06052025-00001
Subject
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM" OR "COMPANY") PROPOSED ACQUISITION BY GENTING ER LIMITED, AN INDIRECT WHOLLY-OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF GENM OF REMAINING 51% MEMBERSHIP INTEREST IN GENTING EMPIRE RESORTS LLC ("GERL") FROM KIEN HUAT REALTY III LIMITED ("KH") ("PROPOSED ACQUISITION")
Description
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM" or "the Company")PROPOSED ACQUISITION BY GENTING ER LIMITED, AN INDIRECT WHOLLY-OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF GENM OF REMAINING 51% MEMBERSHIP INTEREST IN GENTING EMPIRE RESORTS LLC ("GERL") FROM KIEN HUAT REALTY III LIMITED ("KH") ("PROPOSED ACQUISITION")
Query Letter Contents
We refer to your Company’s announcement dated 2 May 2025 in respect of the aforesaid matter.
In this connection, kindly furnish Bursa Securities with the following additional information for public release:-
1. to breakdown the Purchase Consideration of USD41 million and to quantify the purchase consideration and assignment of intercompany loan separately.
2. to incorporate details of the other major assets owned by GERL other than 34.4 million units of Empire’s Common Stocks.
3. to state the basis to arrive at/determine the Purchase Consideration of USD41 million for 51% membership interest in GERL.
4. to state the justifications for the Purchase Consideration of USD41 million (other than on a willing buyer willing seller basis).
5. to clarify whether the “market value range of the Common Stock of USD36.5 million to USD46.9 million” is the market value ascribed for 100% interest in Empire. If yes, to clarify “Purchase Consideration is within the market value range of the Common Stock of USD36.5 million to USD46.9 million” and to state the justifications for the premium paid for the 51% interest in GERL.
6. to state the name of the valuers, date and details of the valuation including key assumptions used to derive at the market value range of the Common Stock of Empire of USD36.5 million to USD46.9 million.
7. to incorporate the valuation methodology to derive at the market value range of the Common Stock of USD36.5 million to USD46.9 million.
8. to state whether any valuation was conducted on GERL. If yes, to provide the name of valuers, date and details of the valuation including key assumptions used.
9. in respect of “Genting ER Limited’s obligations under the Membership Interest Purchase Agreement”, to provide details on the liabilities to be assumed by GENM Group arising from the Proposed Acquisition.
10. to provide details on the guarantee to be assumed by GENM Group arising from the Proposed Acquisition, or an appropriate negative statement.
11. to tabulate the financial information of GERL and Empire for the last 3 years, including the revenue, net profits and net assets.
12. to explain GENM’s intention with regard to the Preferred Stock of Empire held.
13. to state the rationale for acquiring the remining 51% in GERL from KH given that Genting ER Limited already invested substantially in the Preferred Stocks of Empire which is convertible to Common Stocks in Empire.
14. to incorporate a section on the prospects of GERL.
15. to state the time and place where the valuation report(s) may be inspected.
16. for item 5.2 of the announcement, to incorporate the results of GERL since 1 January 2024 in the illustration assuming that the Proposed Acquisition was completed at the beginning of the financial year ended 31 December 2024.
17. to clarify “Step-up acquisition of Empire (remaining 10% economic interest)” amounting to RM7.8 million.
18. to incorporate an explanatory note on “Reversal of expected credit loss on amount due from Empire due to changes in the timing of repayment based on the group’s assessment of the associates’ expected cash flows”, and to state whether this is in accordance with the relevant accounting standard.
19. to incorporate an explanatory note on the increase in the total borrowings from RM12,220.8 million to RM13,497 million.
20. to state whether the Interest Directors have abstained and/or will abstain from Board deliberations and voting on the Proposed Acquisition.
(The definitions used in this announcement shall have the same meanings as that used in our announcement dated 2 May 2025 (“Earlier Announcement”) unless stated otherwise.) All capitalised terms used herein shall, unless otherwise defined, have the same meanings as ascribed thereto in the Earlier Announcement.
We refer to the Earlier Announcement and the letter from Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad dated 6 May 2025 (reference number: IQL-06052025-00001) in relation to the above.
Please refer to the attachment for GENM's responses.
This announcement is dated 8 May 2025.

GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM" OR "COMPANY")SUBMISSION OF THE DOWNSTATE NEW YORK COMMERCIAL CASINO LICENSE BID
In January 2023, the New York Gaming Facility Board (“NYGFB”) had issued a Request for Application (“RFA”) to solicit proposals for up to three commercial casinos in downstate New York, where Resorts World New York City (“RWNYC”) is located.
The GENM Board of Directors wishes to announce that GENM, via its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Genting New York LLC (“GENNY”) had submitted a bid for a commercial casino license (“Bid”) to the New York State Gaming Commission on 27 June 2025 (US Eastern date/time) in response to the RFA.
GENNY owns and operates RWNYC, a gaming destination at the historic Aqueduct Racetrack, currently offering approximately 5,500 slot machines and electronic table games, restaurants and bars, event spaces and a 400-room Hyatt hotel. Having operated in the New York State for nearly 15 years since October 2011, RWNYC is uniquely positioned to transform itself into a world-class integrated resort destination with a proposed multi-billion-dollar investment in conjunction with its Bid. This will drive RWNYC’s next chapter of growth, enabling it to further expand its customer base and market reach.
The NYGFB is expected to make a decision by 1 December 2025, followed by the issuance of licenses by 31 December 2025. GENM will make appropriate announcements once there are further material developments in relation to its Bid.
For more information, please refer to RWNYC’s press release attached to this announcement.
This announcement is dated 30 June 2025.

body:
AI概览：2026年 云顶大马（GENM,4715,主板消费产品服务组) 股价预测
根据各大券商及分析机构在2025年末发布的最新研究报告，云顶大马（GENM，4715）2026年的股价预测与业绩前景如下：
1. 2026年股价目标预测
● 平均预测价： 综合多家机构（如英为财情、Fintel等），2026年的平均目标价约为 RM2.44 至 RM2.53。
● 乐观预测（牛市）： 部分分析师在最佳情境下（考虑纽约赌牌全面落实）将合理价上看到 RM3.00 至 RM3.21。
● 保守预测（熊市）： 最低预测价可能下探至 RM1.83 至 RM2.01，主要受全球经济放缓及汇率波动影响。
2.
关键利好因素（催化剂）
● 纽约全面赌场执照： 云顶大马已于2025年12月正式获得纽约州下州赌牌。纽约市云顶世界（RWNYC）预计将于 2026年第二季度（约6月） 开始以综合度假村模式营运，这将显著贡献2026财年的营收。
● 大马业务复苏： 随着2026年大马旅游年临近，云顶世界（RWG）的游客量和博彩业务预计将保持强劲。
● 派息稳定性： 公司维持半年度派息政策，目前股息收益率约在 4.85% 左右，对长期投资者具备吸引力。
3. 主要风险挑战
● 高额资本支出： 纽约项目的扩建需要巨额资金投入（预计33亿至55亿美元），这可能推高负债比率并面临信用评级下调风险。
● 信用评级展望： 评级机构（如RAM Ratings）已将云顶大马的信用评级展望从“稳定”下调至“负面”，主要是因为母公司云顶（GENTING）增持股份后整体负债水平上升。
● 宏观经济： 全球旅游业虽持乐观态度，但地缘政治紧张局势和全球增长放缓仍可能导致大马博彩市场波动。
4、机构评级参考（2025年12月）
● 丰隆投行 (HLIB)：持有 (Hold)，2.35，上调2026/27年盈利预测
● 机构平均 (13位)：买入 (Buy)，2.53，多数分析师维持看涨或中性
● Fintel预测：2.44，2026年12月预估价
免责声明： 股价预测受市场多种不可控因素影响，上述数据仅供参考，不构成任何投资建议。投资者应自行承担决策风险。

author: FinalRange
body:
我去翻了云顶这次的附加股（rights issue），12.5 亿到底拿去哪里。
8 亿，还一年内到期的贷款。2.8 亿，付利息。剩下的当营运资金。算下来 86% 都回到银行手上，拿去做新生意的，零。
然后我看到它的利息。一年 21 亿。walao。这 12.5 亿，拿去付利息也只够 7 个月左右。
你有 1,000 股的话，它要你拿大概 325 块出来。不出的话，你那一份从 100 变 80。还有，1 块 30 这个价钱是股价还在 1 块 88 的时候算的。现在 1 块 45，如果重新定价，可能接近 1 块，你那一份就剩 75 左右。
我自己有一个表帮马股打分，云顶 24 分（满分 100）。唯一好看的，是股价比账面价值便宜很多。
有拿云顶的，你们会认购，还是放掉？
